call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management only said growth will continue.
Power and transmission is 51% of business; renewables and EV about 7%.
Exports at 12% of volume; target mix of 75% domestic and 25% export.
EBITDA per tonne improved last year and is expected to rise with new value-added products.
Back-to-back hedging on copper and aluminium insulates margins from metal price swings.
₹100 Cr of IPO proceeds used to repay working-capital borrowings.
Middle East crisis has raised ocean freight and packaging costs; supply otherwise not disrupted.
Management declined to quantify product-wise EBITDA per tonne, citing only cumulative margins.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Income Tax Department has completed Block Assessment vide order dated 27.05.2026 passed under Section 158BC read with Section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, determining undisclosed income of Rs.2,92,96,111/- and raising a demand of Rs.1,75,77,666/- on ALCU Industries Private Limited (Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company). The said Company had filed an appeal against the aforesaid order before the Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals) on 20.06.2026, which is pending adjudication. Penalty proceedings initiated pursuant to the said assessment are pending, and the subsidiary has requested the Assessing Officer to keep the same in abeyance till disposal of the appeal against the quantum assessment. Separately, the Income Tax Department has issued a notice under Section 143(2) of the Income Tax Act to the said subsidiary for Assessment Year 2025-26, and the assessment proceedings pursuant thereto are currently pending before the Assessing Officer.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income-tax, Central Circle-3, Vadodara

timeline.summary: Shyamsundar Rathi, on behalf of Vidya Wires Limited’s promoter group (holding 72.80% shares), declared no encumbrances on shares during FY2025-26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹598.78 Cr, net profit ₹19.61 Cr.
Vidya Wires Limited’s Chairman & Whole Time Director Shyamsundar Rathi shared the earnings call recording from May 14, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST on the company’s website.
Vidya Wires' Q4 & FY26 earnings call (14 May 2026) guided ALCU utilisation at 50-60% in FY27 and full 36,000 t by FY28, with FY26 revenue up 24.2% to ₹1,839.6 Cr.
Vidya Wires received a stock exchange clarification notice on its Q4FY26 financial results format under Regulation 33.
Subsidiary ALCU Industries received an income-tax assessment order for ₹1.76 Cr for the block period 2018-2025.
